task: Deploy weight-paint PWA wave 2: Brutal-Fist, AshLane, URBAN-MAYHEM
resume_brief: STANDALONE BRIEF — owner-directed 2026-10-09, wave 2 of the weight-paint PWA deploy. Wave 1 (Bannon PR #53 guided mode, AshLanev2 PR #30, ConcreteDragon PR #14) is DONE and verified. YOUR JOB: deploy the finished PWA (WITH guided fix mode — copy from Bannon's tools/weight-paint-pwa/ on branch weight-paint-guided, PR #53) to three more game repos: (1) Brutal-Fist — local clone ~/workspace/brutalist-fix (origin https://github.com/mhvnsnt/Brutal-Fist); (2) AshLane — local clone ~/workspace/anim-fix (origin https://github.com/mhvnsnt/AshLane.git); (3) URBAN-MAYHEM — local clone ~/workspace/urban-mayhem-port (origin https://github.com/mhvnsnt/URBAN-MAYHEM-.git). RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint every 15 min; do not copy the old pre-guided-mode version — it must include the guided fix mode; report the three PR links when done.
result: Wave 2 complete: 3 PRs opened (Brutal-Fist #24, AshLane #1, URBAN-MAYHEM #4). All include guided fix mode (verified 9 guided refs each), per-repo hero defaults. Note: AshLane is the retired prototype (additive tool only); URBAN-MAYHEM has no GLBs in-repo so it ships with Bannon STICKUP demo model; brutalfist-fix was the correct clone (brutalist-fix does not exist).
